name: Chicken Tikka Tacos
classification_note: Main per founder list; shares marinade/sauces with Paneer Tikka Taco.
cooking_method: Yogurt-spice marinade, high-heat grill/broil to 74 °C, 3 corn tortillas

portion.construction: chopped grilled chicken, onion, hari and raita-crema

steps: Grill/broil on high heat until charred at the edges; probe 74 °C; rest 2 min; chop.
Warm tortillas on the comal; assemble.

plating: Three tacos on a board, lime, extra hari on the side.
food_safety: Cook chicken to 74 °C (165 °F), probed in the thickest piece.
Raw-protein board/utensils separated; hand-wash; marinate at ≤ 4 °C, discard marinade.
Hot-hold ≥ 57 °C (135 °F) or discard within 2 hours (policy to be set by a food-safety professional).

pairing.hypothesis: Soft wheat body and carbonation cut char and marinade.
